property_summary: For any caller address a, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) when a == c.owner() always succeeds and sets c.owner() == newOwner in the reference; the mutant instead only allows calls when stored owner == address(0), so there exist callers a (current owner) and newOwner that make the reference update owner but the mutant will revert or leave owner unchanged.
change_summary: Replace the require with a require that checks owner == address(0), allowing calls only when owner is zero address (thus usually denying the current owner), changing who can call transferOwnership.
